title: Welcome to the Jungle - The better way to find a job in tech
markdown:
## We're moving. Your job search is about to get smarter.

A smarter Welcome to the Jungle experience is ready for you, with more relevant jobs, better company insights, and easier ways to connect with the right companies.

[Find your next job](https://welcometothejungle.com/authenticate/login?source=expansion) [See what's new](https://go.welcometothejungle.com/candidate-migration-live)

![Preview](https://static.otta.com/frontends/search-wttj/assets/Preview-1f0ea2bd.svg)

## Built from what you've told us.

This is more than a new look. It's a smarter way to find jobs that fit, get a clear picture of companies, and connect with hiring teams.

[Get started](https://welcometothejungle.com/authenticate/login?source=expansion)

![](https://static.otta.com/frontends/search-wttj/assets/BetterMatches-9d7f35b2.png)![](https://static.otta.com/frontends/search-wttj/assets/SmarterSearch-991983d6.png)![](https://static.otta.com/frontends/search-wttj/assets/MoreTransparency-a4f4fdf3.png)![](https://static.otta.com/frontends/search-wttj/assets/ClearerConversations-623a355f.png)![](https://static.otta.com/frontends/search-wttj/assets/GetDiscovered-2a578182.png)

## Ready to find a job that fits?

Start exploring more relevant jobs and discover companies that match what you're looking for.

[Find your next job](https://welcometothejungle.com/authenticate/login?source=expansion)

## Stop scrolling, start matching.

Tell us who you are, what you want, and let the magic happen. No endless feed, just job recommendations at companies that truly match.

Better matches
